pattern.description: Clicking the Chrome extension icon opens a popup that first shows as an empty white panel, then paints its full form (Project, Ideas, Add to idea URL, quoted selection, Add/Cancel); the Project field then resolves from placeholder to 'John testing JPD'. Timed to 'include and attach'.
pattern.why_premium: Shows the capture flow end to end in real UI: the selected text and URL arrive pre-filled in the popup, proving the 'highlight and attach' claim in one glance without any added graphics.

build_hint.gsap: Recreation: tl.fromTo(popup, {autoAlpha: 0, y: -8, scale: 0.98, transformOrigin: 'top right'}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out'}).from(popup.querySelectorAll('.field'), {autoAlpha: 0, y: 6, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.03}, '-=0.05').set(projectValue, {textContent: 'John testing JPD'}, '+=0.25'); cursor: gsap.to(cursor, {x, y, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}). Faithful replica uses gsap.set steps (blank panel 1-2 frames, then content).
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 260, mass: 0.8}}); popup opacity = p, translateY = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [-8, 0]); fields stagger by 1 frame with the same spring; project label switches text at a fixed frame (step). Faithful replica: blank panel for 1-2 frames, then full content, no spring.

notes: Screen recording of a real extension popup, so all motion is step changes; skeleton_resolve chosen for the blank-panel-then-content load (notification_pop also plausible).
